items.title: Tyner McCoy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I guess he said jokingly that they called your band the “starvation band.”

ctx.x: Well, that’s what some of us are (laughs) and some of us hope that we’re not (laughs).

This period seems to be one where you’re, you know Blue Note, Impulse, record labels, but Woody Shaw recalled that there was a lot of difficulty in getting work at this period in time. One of the biographies I researched said that you had actually played with Ike and Tina Turner during this period, is that correct?
